'''[[Shange]]''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] and hero on his homeworld who opposed the Cathar joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In [[3661 BBY]], [[Agent/Legends|Agents]] with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] took Shange and some of his followers captive and placed them in stasis in the SIS's [[The Tomb]] prison on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Twenty years later, [[Imperial Non-human Relations|Imperial Non-Human Relations]] learned of his imprisonment and sent operatives to free him and his allies so their story could create a scandal for the Republic and the SIS, thereby leading more [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to join the Empire.<ref name="oncefuture" />
